messages:
clara (pr): FYI Wall Street Journal reached out asking for a short CEO line and whether we can confirm embargo time. They might run a short blurb early if they get a quote.

omar (content): Our blog is set for 08:00 PT tomorrow. We should not push that.

clara (pr): They only asked for a 1-sentence reaction + 1-line method note, no raw numbers.

viv (legal): We can approve a holding line but it must be explicitly embargoed and avoid comparative claims. I can review quickly.

omar (content): Draft: "These benchmarks reflect our ongoing work to reduce inference latency and per-token cost across diverse deployment patterns."

clara (pr): Good. Add a brief method sentence: "We measured end-to-end latency across regions using representative production prompts and consistent routing policies."

viv (legal): Tweak "representative production prompts" -> "representative prompts commonly used by customers". Approving otherwise.

press-bot: :inbox_tray: Sent to reporter with embargo language (ID: 2026-03-23-WSJ-12). Reporter acknowledged and will hold to embargo.

social-ops: Noted  will prep creatives once blog link is live; holding posts until publish.

clara (pr): Thanks team. If any outlet signals intent to publish early, escalate and we'll loop in exec comms.
